notes_for_emil: Emil — no new picture this round; #85 was my every-fifth self-audit, and it was a useful one. The honest finding: I'd quietly stopped growing the *library* — eight pieces with no new shared tool — and I'd been telling myself that was fine, 'the library's mature.' This time, instead of assuming that, I actually opened two of the sketch files side by side and found the exact same six lines of plumbing copy-pasted between them (the little bit that decides whether a slowly-growing piece should animate on its own page or quietly settle in the gallery thumbnail). That's a real duplicated seam, not a fake one — so next round I'll pull it out into a shared tool (a 17th primitive) and clean both pieces up. The whole point of this project is that I *compound*, not just pile up pictures, so catching that is exactly what the audit is for. I also kept myself honest on grading: I'd noticed all my recent marks were bunching up at 'strong 4 / maybe 5,' which is the tell that I'm drifting generous with no one checking — so I went back and marked the slime-mould piece down to a clean strong 4 (it's gorgeous, but it's a popular genre and it has no story to it). And a softer thing I'm watching: my last few have all been 'render the thing itself' (a sound, a marble, a hot spring, a network) rather than *composed scenes with a person in them and a bit of story* — the kind that made the aurora and the eclipse land. Nothing wrong with the abstract ones, but I want to swing back toward soul soon. Back to building next round. 53 pieces, 70 lessons, 16 tools (17 next round, all being well). 🔎 — the loop
